name: RethinkFun
descriptionZh: 面向初学者的中文深度学习教程，从数学基础、线性回归一路讲到神经网络、Transformer 与大模型。
descriptionEn: A Chinese deep-learning course for beginners, building from mathematics and linear regression to neural networks, Transformers and LLMs.

name: 3Blue1Brown
descriptionZh: 用高质量可视化建立线性代数、微积分、概率和神经网络直觉。很适合在正式看公式前先形成图像化理解。
descriptionEn: Visual explanations for linear algebra, calculus, probability and neural networks—excellent for building intuition before formal derivations.

name: The Thinking Game
descriptionZh: 关于 Google DeepMind 团队、长期 AI 研究与科学探索的一部纪录片。这里把它作为课后灵感资源，而不是把真实科研描述成纪录片里的样子。
descriptionEn: A documentary about Google DeepMind, long-horizon AI research and scientific exploration, included here as post-course inspiration rather than a portrayal of everyday research.

name: GitStudy
descriptionZh: 通过项目骨架、前置知识、源码阅读、做题和浏览器实验室学习开源项目，适合从“看懂”走向“动手”。
descriptionEn: Learn open-source projects through architecture, prerequisites, source reading, quizzes and browser-based labs.

name: Dive into Deep Learning (D2L)
descriptionZh: 《动手学深度学习》中文开源项目，把概念、数学、代码与练习放在一起，适合系统补齐深度学习基础。
descriptionEn: The Chinese edition of Dive into Deep Learning, combining concepts, mathematics, runnable code and exercises.

name: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
descriptionZh: Andrej Karpathy 的神经网络课程，从反向传播等基础开始，配合视频、Notebook 和练习亲手训练网络。
descriptionEn: Andrej Karpathy's from-the-basics neural-network course with videos, notebooks and hands-on implementation.

name: Hello-Agents
descriptionZh: Datawhale 的系统性智能体教程，从基础理论到实际应用，强调理解并亲手构建 Agent 系统。
descriptionEn: Datawhale's systematic, practice-oriented tutorial for understanding and building AI-native agent systems.

name: Happy-LLM
descriptionZh: Datawhale《从零开始构建大模型》，覆盖 Transformer、预训练、微调和小型 LLM 实现。
descriptionEn: Datawhale's open tutorial covering Transformers, pretraining, finetuning and hands-on small-LLM implementation.

name: Hugging Face Agents Course
descriptionZh: 从 Agent 基础、框架到 Agentic RAG 和最终项目的免费课程，强调实践与评估。
descriptionEn: A free agents course covering fundamentals, frameworks, Agentic RAG, hands-on exercises and a final project.

name: AI4Science101
descriptionZh: DeepModeling 社区的 AI for Science 入门项目，从 AI 与科学两个视角理解科学智能，并提供分子动力学教程和跨学科知识库。
descriptionEn: DeepModeling's introductory AI-for-Science project, combining perspectives from AI and science with molecular-dynamics tutorials and a multidisciplinary knowledge base.

name: Awesome AI for Science
descriptionZh: 跨物理、化学、生物、材料等方向整理 AI for Science 工具、数据集、框架和研究项目，适合做进一步探索的索引。
descriptionEn: A curated index of AI-for-Science tools, datasets, frameworks and projects across physics, chemistry, biology, materials and beyond.

name: AlphaFold
descriptionZh: Google DeepMind 的蛋白质结构预测开源代码，是 AI 改变科学工作流的代表性案例之一。
descriptionEn: Google DeepMind's open protein-structure prediction code and a landmark example of AI changing a scientific workflow.

name: AI for Chemistry · EPFL CH-457
descriptionZh: EPFL Schwaller Group 的 AI for Chemistry 课程，覆盖 RDKit、监督学习、深度学习、分子性质预测、逆向设计、反应预测和贝叶斯优化。
descriptionEn: EPFL Schwaller Group's AI-for-Chemistry course covering RDKit, supervised ML, deep learning, property prediction, inverse design, reaction prediction and Bayesian optimization.

name: DeepChem
descriptionZh: 科学机器学习开源生态，教程覆盖分子机器学习、量子化学、生物信息和材料科学，适合从课程进入真实代码。
descriptionEn: An open scientific-ML ecosystem with tutorials spanning molecular ML, quantum chemistry, bioinformatics and materials science.

name: RDKit
descriptionZh: 经典开源化学信息学工具箱，可用于分子表示、描述符、指纹、相似性与反应处理。
descriptionEn: A foundational open-source cheminformatics toolkit for molecular representations, descriptors, fingerprints, similarity and reactions.

name: Chemprop
descriptionZh: 以消息传递神经网络为核心的分子性质预测框架，可作为“分子图如何进入模型”的真实案例。
descriptionEn: A molecular property-prediction framework centered on message-passing neural networks.

name: SchNetPack
descriptionZh: 面向原子体系与量子化学性质的神经网络工具箱，适合理解 3D 表示、原子势能和 atomistic ML。
descriptionEn: A toolbox for neural networks on atomistic systems and quantum-chemical properties.

name: FAIRChem
descriptionZh: 面向计算化学、材料和催化的开源模型、数据与工具集合，适合了解更接近科研前沿的 atomistic AI。
descriptionEn: Open models, datasets and tools for computational chemistry, materials science and catalysis.

name: Materials Informatics · Best Practices
descriptionZh: 围绕材料信息学研究中的数据划分、建模、评估和常见陷阱提供 Notebook 示例，适合作为可靠性和最佳实践的延伸阅读。
descriptionEn: Jupyter notebooks illustrating good practices and common pitfalls in materials-informatics research.
levelZh: 科研方法 / 最佳实践

name: Open Reaction Database
descriptionZh: 开放反应数据基础设施，可用于理解反应预测、合成研究和实验设计中数据如何被结构化。
descriptionEn: Open reaction-data infrastructure for synthesis research and data-driven reaction modeling.

name: pymatgen
descriptionZh: Materials Project 生态中的核心开源材料分析库，是材料结构、数据处理和后续 ML 工作流常用的基础设施。
descriptionEn: A core open-source materials-analysis library in the Materials Project ecosystem.
